name: O - The Fool
description: Teleports the player to the first room of the current floor There is a guaranteed Fool card in the Depths 2, if you bomb the skull with an X on it. This is intended give you a guaranteed way to teleport out of the Mom's Foot fight, for accessing the path to the Mausoleum floor

name: I - The Magician
quote: May you never miss your goal
description: For the current room, tears now have the Spoon Bender effect, which allows them to curve towards enemies and gives them a purple appearance.

name: II - The High Priestess
description: Summons Mom's foot which will stomp on a random enemy in the current room, dealing 300 damage If no enemies are in the current room, the foot will target Isaac (and do damage if it hits), however it can be used to break rocks

name: III - The Empress
description: Gives the player the Whore of Babylon effect for the current room, increasing damage and speed

name: IV - The Emperor
description: Teleports the player to the Boss room on the current floor

name: V - The Hierophant
description: Spawns 2 Soul hearts on the floor

name: VI - The Lovers
quote: May you prosper and be in good health
description: Spawns 2 red hearts on the floor If used in a Super Secret Room containing a Black Heart or Eternal Heart, it will spawn those types of hearts instead

name: VII - The Chariot
description: Grants the same effect as 'My Little Unicorn', which makes Isaac invincible and deal 40 contact damage to enemies per hit

name: VIII - Justice
description: Spawns 1 bomb, 1 key, 1 coin, 1 heart, which can be random variants of each

name: IX - The Hermit
quote: May you see what life has to offer
description: Teleports the player to the Shop On or below the Womb, this acts as a random teleport, since there are no shops on those floors

name: X - Wheel of Fortune
description: Spawns a Slot Machine or a Fortune Machine

name: XI - Strength
description: Gives the player the Magic Mushroom effect, which increasing size and all stats by 1 for the current room If you use the Strength card with 12 heart containers, it will take you down to 11 when you leave the room

name: XII - The Hanged Man
description: Gives the player the flying effect for the current room, allowing the player to fly over obstacles in the room This card is useless if you have any item which allows you to permanently fly

name: XIII - Death
quote: Lay waste to all that oppose you
description: Deals 40 damage to all enemies in the room in a similar style to the Necronomicon

name: XIV - Temperance
quote: May you be pure in heart
description: Spawns a Blood Donation Machine

name: XV - The Devil
quote: Revel in the power of your darkness
description: Gives the Book of Belial effect for the current room, increasing damage

name: XVI - The Tower
description: Spawns some troll bombs at random locations in the current room Each bomb deals 60 damage (normal bomb damage

name: XVII - The Stars
quote: May you find what you desire
description: Teleports the player to the Item Room On or below the Womb, this acts as a random teleport, since there are no item rooms on those floors

name: XVIII - The Moon
quote: May you find all you have lost
description: Teleports the player to the Secret Room

name: XIX - The Sun
quote: May the light heal and enlighten you
description: A card with three uses: A full heal, deals 100 damage to all enemies in the current room and reveals the entire map for the current floor (Treasure Map + The Compass)

name: XX - Judgement
description: Spawns a beggar Has a chance to be a demon beggar Killing a Devil Beggar, Key Master, or Shell Game Beggar gives you an increased chance of finding Angel rooms instead of Devil rooms. See the dedicated Devil room page for more details

name: XXI - The World
description: Reveals the entire map and shows the icons for every room which has one This is completely useless if you currently have both the Treasure Map and The Compass

name: 2 of Clubs
description: Doubles the number of Bombs you have If you have no bombs, it gives you two

name: 2 of Diamonds
description: Doubles the number of coins you have If you have no coins, it gives you two

name: 2 of Spades
description: Doubles the number of keys you have If you have no keys, it gives you two

name: 2 of Hearts
description: Doubles your current red hearts up to full health This card is useless for the Bluе Baby

name: Ace of Clubs
description: When used, turns all pickups, chests and non-boss enemies in the room into Bombs Unlock this item by getting a 3 win streak

name: Ace of Diamonds
description: When used, turns all pickups, chests and non-boss enemies in the room into Coins Unlock this item by defeating The Lamb in under 20 minutes

name: Ace of Spades
description: When used, turns all pickups, chests and non-boss enemies in the room into Keys Unlock this item by defeating The Lamb without taking hearts, coins and bombs

name: Ace of Hearts
description: When used, turns all pickups, chests and non-boss enemies in the room into Hearts Unlock this item by defeating any floor after Basement I with only half a heart of health (works as The Lost)

name: The Joker
description: Teleports you to the Devil Deal Room on the current floor

name: Suicide King
description: When used, instantly kills you and spawns 10 pickup on the floor Each of the 10 things spawned can be any type of consumable or sometimes a pedestal item (up to a maximum of 3 pedestal items) Any pedestal item created by Suicide King will be related to the room where it was used, meaning that using it in the Angel room will spawn Angel room items Unlock this card by beating Challenge #7 (Suicide King)

name: Queen of Hearts
description: Drops 1-20 full red hearts on the floor Unlock this card by defeating Mega Satan as Tainted Magdalene

name: Chaos Card
description: A card which can be thrown as a projectile directly infront of Isaac, instantly killing anything it hits, including most bosses If thrown at a multi-phase boss with multiple forms such Satan, Mega Satan or Hush it will only kill that particular phase of the boss If thrown at a multi-phase boss that works from a single health bar such as Isaac, ??? or The Lamb, it will die instantly Will not kill Delirium or The Beast Will destroy rocks and poop in its path Can also be thrown against a door to open it (Doesn't work against Mega Satan's door) Throwing this at the Great Gideon boss will trigger a special animation and reveal a crawl space containing several chests and items! Unlock this card by beating Challenge #9 (Demo Man)

name: Huge Growth
description: Temporarily makes Isaac huge, giving him +7 Damage Up and +30 Range Up for the rest of the current room Added as part of the Afterbirth+ Booster Pack #1 and based on the Steam Workshop mod created by Coper140 Unlock this item by getting 5 items or consumables that increase your size, e.g. 'One Makes you Larger' pills, Magic Mushroom etc

name: Ancient Recall
description: Spawns 3 random cards on the floor when used Added as part of the Afterbirth+ Booster Pack #1 and based on the Steam Workshop mod created by Coper140

name: Era Walk
description: When used, this card will slow down enemies, Isaac's tears by -1 Shot Speed, but speed up Isaac's movement speed by +0.50 for the rest of the current room Added as part of the Afterbirth+ Booster Pack #1 and based on the Steam Workshop mod created by Coper140 Unlock this item by getting both the Broken Watch and the Stop Watch in your collection

name: Credit Card
description: When used, removes the price tag from all items in the current shop or devil deal, making everything free The effect of the Credit Card only lasts for the current room Unlock this card by beating Challenge #10 (Cursed!)

name: Rules Card
description: Displays a random cryptic message on the screen similar to the fortune machine ones. One of the following messages may show: 'Rooms may yield more than you expect' 'Some doors require a blessing. Carry them with you' 'The walls will harden over time. Time is the essence' 'Sleeping gatekeepers will need to be awoken with a loud sound' 'A piece of paper is your guide' 'Deny his gifts to attain your reward' 'A dark market lies under your feet 'Chub dislikes smoke!' Unlock this card by beating Challenge #11 (Glass Cannon)

name: Card Against Humanity
description: When used, fills the entire room with poop! Unlock this card by beating Challenge #12 (When Life Gives You Lemons)

name: Get Out Of Jail Free Card
description: When used, will open all doors in the current room, similar to a one-time use of Dad's Key Unlock this card by beating Challenge #22 (Speed)

name: ? Card
description: When used this card will activate a use of your spacebar item for free

name: Rune of Hagalaz
description: When used, this rune will destroy all breakable objects in the current room, such as poop, rocks, secret room entrances This includes Key Blocks Unlock this card by beating Challenge #1 (Pitch Black)

name: Rune of Jera
description: When used this rune will double all pickups on the floor in the room Creates copies of pickups in the Shop which can be taken for free, even if you haven't purchased them yet Can be used to double the number of item chests in the first room of the final Chest / Dark Room floors Cloned chests have the same types of items as the first one Cannot be used to clone trinkets or other Jera runes Unlock this card by beating Challenge #2 (High Brow)

name: Rune of Ehwaz
description: Creates a trapdoor on the floor Digging in certain spots with objects or markings on the floor will guarantee a crawlspace once per floor Unlock this card by beating Challenge #3 (Head Trauma)

name: Rune of Dagaz
description: Removes the curse which is in effect on the current floor (except Curse of the Labyrinth) Can also cure the effect of the Amnesia pill +1 Soul Heart Unlock this card by beating Challenge #4 (Darkness Falls)

name: Rune of Ansuz
description: When used, reveals the entire map including all the secret room locations and other icon rooms Unlock this card by beating Challenge #5 (The Tank)

name: Rune of Perthro
description: Rerolls all pedestal items in the current room (One time use of the D6) Unlock this card by beating Challenge #6 (Solar System)

name: Rune of Berkano
description: Summons 3 blue friendly spiders and 3 blue flies Unlock this card by beating Challenge #20 (Purist)

name: Rune of Algiz
description: When used, gives you an invincibility effect which lasts for 20 seconds Unlock this card by beating Challenge #8 (Cat Got Your Tongue)

name: Blank Rune
description: When used, gives a random Mystic rune effect Possible effects include: Algiz, Ansuz, Berkano, Dagaz, Ehwaz, Hagalaz, Jera, Perthro Also has a 25% chance to spawn another Blank Rune upon use Unlock this card by beating Challenge #30 (Guardian)

name: Black Rune
description: When used, this rune deals 40 damage to all enemies in the room and consumes all pedestal items in the room, giving you a random stat increase for each item consumed Also consumes all pickups in the room and turns them into blue flies and spiders Unlock this item by beating Greedier mode as Apollyon

name: Rune Shard
description: Activates a random rune effect. The effect is weaker than normal runes. These only appear if not all runes have been unlocked yet.

name: Dice Shard
description: Gives a one-time use of the D6 and D20 effects at the same time

name: Emergency Contact
description: When used will cause two of Mom's Hand to come down and grab a random enemy

name: Holy Card
description: Grants the Holy Mantle effect for, which will negate your next hit of damage The effect persist between rooms/floors Tainted Lost starts with this card, and while playing as this character all cards and runes have a 10% chance to turn into a Holy Card Unlock this item by defeating Delirium in The Void floor with The Lost

name: Cracked Key
description: This is a one-time use of the Red Key item. The main purpose of the Cracked Key is to unlock Tainted character in the Home floor without needing to find the Red Key. You can force spawn a cracked key by droping any trinket in a Boss Room or Item room, on any floor on your way down to Depths II. When you take the reverse path back up to Home, the trinket will turn into Cracked Key in the same floor/room you dropped it before. Unlock this card by opening Mom's Box on the Home floor.

name: O - The Fool?
description: When used, this card drops all of your hearts (including non-red hearts), coins, keys and bombs on the floor This effect is done in the most efficient way possible - e.g. if you have 99 coins it will create 3 x Quarters, 2 Dimes and 4 Pennies. If you have 40 bombs it will spawn 4 x Boom! pedestal items Picking up all dropped items leaves you with the same health and consumables you had before This allows you to manipulate your consumables in lots of different ways, for example by rerolling them with the D6/D20, re-arrange your Bone heart containers and more If you have the Tarot Cloth item, this card will also drop all your passive items on the floor as pedestals Unlock this card by defeating Ultra Greedier mode as Tainted Lost

name: I - The Magician?
quote: May no harm come to you
description: Gives you a blue aura that repels enemy projectiles, causing them to slowly curve away from Isaac and avoid hitting him Lasts for 60 seconds Unlock this card by defeating Ultra Greedier mode as Tainted Judas

name: II - The High Priestess?
description: Causes Mom's Foot to keep stomping down randomly for 60 seconds where Isaac is standing Unlock this card by defeating Ultra Greedier mode as Tainted Lilith

name: III - The Empress?
description: Gives 2 HP Up and +1.5 Tears Up for 60 seconds Unlock this card by defeating Ultra Greedier mode as Tainted Eve

name: IV - The Emperor?
quote: May you find a worthy opponent
description: Teleports you to an extra boss room, that drops a Boss room item as normal. This room isn't part of the actual floor, and leaving it returns you to where you teleported from The boss isn't necessarily from the current floor - e.g. you could find a caves boss in the basement Unlock this card by defeating Ultra Greedier mode as Tainted ???

name: V - The Hierophant?
description: Spawns 2 Bone hearts on the floor Unlock this card by defeating Ultra Greedier mode as Tainted Bethany

name: VI - The Lovers?
quote: May your heart shatter to pieces
description: Spawns a random pedestal item from the current room's item pool In exchange, turns one heart container or 2 soul hearts into a broken heart. Broken hearts permanently subtract from your total possible health containers Unlock this card by defeating Ultra Greedier mode as Tainted Magdalene

name: VII - The Chariot?
description: Isaac turns to stone and can't move for 10 seconds, but your tear rate goes up significantly for the duration Unlock this card by defeating challenge #42 (Hot Potato)

name: VIII - Justice?
quote: May your sins come back to torment you
description: Spawns 2-4 locked gold chests Unlock this card by defeating challenge #43 (Cantripped)

name: IX - The Hermit?
quote: May you see the value of all things in life
description: When used, all items and pickups in the current room are turned into money. Everything is sold for its shop price, e.g. Items for 15c, hearts for 3c, sacks for 7c Unlock this card by defeating challenge #44 (Red Redemption)

name: X - Wheel of Fortune?
description: Activates a random effect from a Dice room See the dice icon above for each possible effect Unlock this card by defeating Ultra Greedier mode as Tainted Cain

name: XI - Strength?
description: All enemies in the current room are slowed and take double damage Unlock this card by defeating Ultra Greedier mode as Tainted Samson

name: XII - The Hanged Man?
quote: May your greed know no bounds
description: You turn into the Keeper, gaining triple shot, -0.1 Speed Down for 30 seconds Enemies drop random coins while this effect is active Unlock this card by defeating Ultra Greedier mode as Tainted Keeper

name: XIII - Death?
quote: May life spring forth from the fallen
description: Activates the Book of the Dead effect, spawning a bone orbital or charmed Bony for each enemy killed in the current room Unlock this card by defeating Ultra Greedier mode as Tainted Forgotten

name: XIV - Temperance?
description: When used, this card activates 5 random pill effects one after the other Unlock this card by defeating challenge #45 (DELETE THIS)

name: XV - The Devil?
quote: Bask in the light of your mercy
description: Activates The Bible effect (granting flight) and gives a Seraphim familiar for 30 seconds Unlock this card by defeating Ultra Greedier mode as Tainted Azazel

name: XVI - The Tower?
description: Spawns 6 clusters of rocks and objects that normally appear on this floor It won't block any doors that exist Rocks have a pretty good chance to become tinted rocks Unlock this card by defeating Ultra Greedier mode as Tainted Apollyon

name: XVII - The Stars?
description: Removes your oldest item and spawns 2 pedestal items from the current room's pool Can remove either passive or active items Doesn't remove your character's starting items Unlock this card by defeating Ultra Greedier mode as Tainted Isaac

name: XVIII - The Moon?
description: Teleports you to the ultra secret room on the floor The ultra secret room is a red room containing an item from the angel room item pool. Can only be accessed via the Red Key, Crystal Key or Cracked Key. Using this card will also open a pathway of red rooms back to the regular floor Unlock this card by defeating Ultra Greedier mode as Tainted Jacob

name: XIX - The Sun?
quote: May the darkness swallow all around you
description: When used, grants +1.5 Damage Up, turns your hearts to Bone hearts and the Spirit of the Night effect (Spectral tears and the ability to fly) for the current floor Also gives the Curse of Darkness effect that can't be removed for the current floor Unlock this card by defeating Ultra Greedier mode as Tainted Jacob

name: XX - Judgement?
quote: May you redeem those found wanting
description: Spawns a Restock machine Unlock this card by defeating Ultra Greedier mode as Tainted Lazarus

name: XXI - The World?
description: Creates a trapdoor to a guaranteed crawl space Unlock this card by defeating Ultra Greedier mode as Tainted Eden

name: Wild Card
description: When used, this copies the effect of the card, pill, rune, soul stone or active item you used most recently Unlock this card by defeating Mega Satan as Tainted Eden

name: Soul of Isaac
description: Turns all pedestal items in the current room into rotating items, which cycle between the old item and a random new item every second This allows you to effectively reroll items like with The D6, but choose the old item as well if you want Tainted Isaac has this effect passively for all items If you use more than one in the same room, each pedestal item will cycle through +1 random item Items are chosen from the item pool related to the current item Unlock this item by defeating Hush and Boss Rush as Tainted Isaac

name: Soul of Magdalene
description: When used, all enemies in the current room drop half a red heart that will disappear after 2 seconds if not picked up Unlock this item by defeating Hush and Boss Rush as Tainted Magdalene

name: Soul of Cain
description: When used, this Soul Stone creates Red rooms for every possible exit in the current room Red outlines of doors appear where this Soul Stone will create exits for See the Red Key item description for more information about these Red rooms behave Unlock this item by defeating Hush and Boss Rush as Tainted Cain

name: Soul of Judas
description: Activates the Dark Arts item effect, which turns Isaac into a ghost for a few seconds. While in this form you can walk over enemies to mark them for death. After a few seconds, he will quickly attack each target, chaining higher damage for each enemy it hits Unlock this item by defeating Hush and Boss Rush as Tainted Judas

name: Soul of ???
description: When used this will cause 8 poison farts that leave a brown creep behind, and then drop 7 Butt Bombs very quickly Standing in the creep gives you +1 Damage Up and +1.35 Tears Up Unlock this item by defeating Hush and Boss Rush as Tainted Blue Baby

name: Soul of Eve
description: For the current room, 14 Dead Birds fly in from off the screen and attack all enemies, dealing low but frequent damage Unlock this item by defeating Hush and Boss Rush as Tainted Eve

name: Soul of Samson
description: Isaac gains the Berserk! effect for 10 seconds. This gives Isaac a bone sword and he goes on a killing rampage, gaining +0.4 Speed, +3 Flat Damage Up Unlock this item by defeating Hush and Boss Rush as Tainted Samson

name: Soul of Azazel
description: Activates the Mega Blast item effect, which gives you a giant laser that deals x5 your tear damage per tick to anything in its path and pushing Isaac back by the force The effect lasts for 8 seconds but does persist between rooms Unlock this item by defeating Hush and Boss Rush as Tainted Azazel

name: Soul of Lazarus
description: When used this kills Isaac and revives him with 1/2 a red heart. You get a couple of seconds of invincibility to move away after The main benefit of this Soul Stone is that it automatically activates if you die, meaning it is effectively an extra passive life while held Unlock this item by defeating Hush and Boss Rush as Tainted Lazarus

name: Soul of Eden
description: Activates the D6 and D20 effects, rerolling all items and pickups in the room. Unlike the regular D6, rerolled items can pick from any item pool Unlock this item by defeating Hush and Boss Rush as Tainted Eden

name: Soul of the Lost
description: When used, Isaac dies and becomes The Lost for the current room. This gives you his ability to fly, and the Holy Mantle effect. However if you take damage a second time you die like the Lost does Same effect as touching a white fire, but only lasts one room Unlock this item by defeating Hush and Boss Rush as Tainted Lost

name: Soul of Lilith
description: Gives you 1 random permanent familiar Unlock this item by defeating Hush and Boss Rush as Tainted Lilith

name: Soul of the Keeper
description: Spawns up to 25 random coins on the floor Unlock this item by defeating Hush and Boss Rush as Tainted Keeper

name: Soul of Apollyon
description: Creates 15 random Locusts Locusts are variants of blue flies, except they have special effects based on the color War (Red) - Explodes when touching the enemy. The actual explosion deals flat 60 damage Pestilence (Green) - Poisons the enemy it attacks Famine (Brown) - Applies a slowing effect Death (Black) - Deals x4 damage instead of x2 Conquest (White) - Spawns 2-5 at once Unlock this item by defeating Hush and Boss Rush as Tainted Apollyon

name: Soul of the Forgotten
description: Gives you The Forgotten as a temporary familiar, with 2 Bone hearts and his bone weapon. He behaves the same as how Esau works with Jacob, following your exact movements Disappears after the current room or if he takes enough damage and dies Unlock this item by defeating Hush and Boss Rush as Tainted Forgotten

name: Soul of Bethany
description: Creates 6 wisps, similar to the Book of Virtues effect Mosts wisps will be the standard blue ones, but have a chance to have random special properties Unlock this item by defeating Hush and Boss Rush as Tainted Bethany

name: Soul of Jacob and Esau
description: Spawns Esau as a temporary familiar, who copies your exact movements the same as how the Jacob & Esau character works Disappears after the current room or if he takes enough damage and dies Unlock this item by defeating Hush and Boss Rush as Tainted Jacob
